name: Moody Monkes Reborn
summary:
Moody Monkes Reborn is an immersive social VR world where style, attitude, and evolution collide. Dive into a vibrant facility of expression and creativity, where each Monke has a personality as wild as the environments they inhabit. Whether you're swinging through dynamic biomes, customizing your avatar, or vibing with the community — this is your space to be unapologetically you.
